name: ai-status-bar
description: Track Codex, Claude Code, and Devin usage in the VS Code status bar.

aiStatusBar.pollSeconds.description: How often to poll agent usage APIs, in seconds.

aiStatusBar.barCells.description: Number of segments in each status-bar progress bar.

aiStatusBar.showWeekly.description: Show the secondary weekly or billing-cycle usage bar in each agent status item. The primary 5-hour or daily bar is otherwise always shown.

aiStatusBar.replacePrimaryWithWeeklyOnLi.description: When the secondary weekly or billing-cycle limit is reached, show that exhausted budget in the primary status-bar slot instead of the 5-hour or daily budget.

enumDescriptions: Use each agent's native display style.
Show used percentage and gauge segments for all agents.
Show remaining percentage and gauge segments for all agents.
aiStatusBar.presentationMode.description: Whether usage gauges display used or remaining percentage.

aiStatusBar.cautionAt.description: Used percentage at which the status dot turns yellow.

aiStatusBar.warnAt.description: Used percentage at which the status dot turns red and a warning popup can appear.

aiStatusBar.locale.description: BCP-47 locale for dates/times, for example de-DE. Empty means system locale.

aiStatusBar.claude.enabled.description: Enable or disable Claude detection and status display.

aiStatusBar.codex.enabled.description: Enable or disable Codex detection and status display.

aiStatusBar.codex.command.description: Codex command or executable path used to start `codex app-server`.

aiStatusBar.devin.enabled.description: Enable or disable Devin detection and status display.

aiStatusBar.devin.apiKeyEnv.description: Optional environment variable containing a Devin API key for the documented API fallback. Normal Devin IDE usage is read from the local Devin usage cache.

aiStatusBar.devin.apiBaseUrl.description: Base URL for the Devin API.

aiStatusBar.devin.orgId.description: Devin organization ID. If empty, the extension tries to read it from `/v3/self`.

aiStatusBar.devin.userId.description: Devin user ID to query for consumption.

aiStatusBar.devin.cycleAcuLimit.description: Optional Devin cycle ACU/quota limit. If unset or 0, the extension uses the organization cycle limit when the API returns one.

aiStatusBar.devin.usageFile.description: Optional local JSON usage file override for Devin usage snapshots.

scripts.bump:compile: npm version patch --no-git-tag-version && npm run compile
